name: MCB 2400
title: Human Genetics
description: Foundational principles of classical genetics and modern genomics with a specific focus on humans. Emphasis on case studies and applications to human genetic diseases.
requirement_description: BIOL 1107; not open to students who have passed MCB 2410. May not be taken out of sequence after passing MCB 3220, 3400, 3410, 3412, 3413, 3843W, or 4416.
